- `public bool IsCustom { get; }`

- `public Variant Callv(Collections.Array arguments)` - Calls it with the arguments in an array.

- `public Error RpcId(long peerId, params Variant[] args)` - Calls the node method this callable names as an RPC on one peer (GDScript's func.rpc_id(peer, args)).

- `public Callable Unbind(int argCount)` - A callable that drops the last argCount arguments it is called with.

### FabricSpace

`public static class FabricSpace` - Godot space (metres, +Y up, -Z forward, right-handed) to Aver space (centimetres, +Z up, +X forward, left-handed).

- `public const float CmPerMetre = 100f` - Centimetres in a metre: the unit change on positions and sizes.
- `public static Vec3 ToAverPosition(Vector3 p)` - A position in metres to Aver centimetres.
- `public static Vector3 FromAverPosition(Vec3 p)` - A position in Aver centimetres to Godot metres.
- `public static Vec3 ToAverDirection(Vector3 d)` - A direction or any unitless vector: the axis map without the unit change.
- `public static Vector3 FromAverDirection(Vec3 d)`
- `public static Vec3 ToAverAngular(Vector3 w)` - An angular velocity, torque or any rotation axis scaled by an angle: the map of the quaternion's vector part, (x, y, z) to (z, -x, -y).
- `public static Vector3 FromAverAngular(Vec3 w)`
- `public static float ToAverLength(float metres)` - A length in metres to centimetres (no axis).
- `public static float FromAverLength(float cm)`
- `public static Quat ToAverRotation(Quaternion q)` - A rotation quaternion.
- `public static Quaternion FromAverRotation(Quat q)`
- `public static Vec3 ToAverScale(Vector3 s)` - A scale: dimensionless, so it permutes with the axes only.
- `public static Vector3 FromAverScale(Vec3 s)`
- `public static void ToAver(Transform3D t, out Vec3 position, out Quat rotation, out Vec3 scale)` - A Godot transform as the position, rotation and scale an Aver entity stores.
- `public static void ToAverMatrix12(Transform3D t, float[] dest, int offset = 0)` - A Godot affine transform as the engine's instance matrix: 12 floats, the row-vector world matrix with its 4th column dropped (three basis rows, then the translation in centimetres), written at offset.
- `public static void ToAverTangent(Vector3 normal, Vector3 tangent, float handedness, float[] dest, int offset)` - The tangent the engine stores for a vertex whose Godot normal and tangent (xyz and handedness) are given (G4 R1's contract): the unit tangent made orthogonal to the normal, and w = +1/-1 so that cross(N, T) * w points along increasing v.
- `public static Transform3D FromAver(Vec3 position, Quat rotation, Vec3 scale)` - An Aver entity's position, rotation and scale as a Godot transform.

### Node

`public class Node : GodotObject` - A node of the scene tree (Godot's Node).

- `public MultiplayerApi? Multiplayer { get; }` - The multiplayer API of the branch this node is in: the one a SceneTree.SetMultiplayer call named for an ancestor path, else the tree's default.
- `public int GetMultiplayerAuthority()` - The peer that owns this node: it may call authority-mode RPCs and sends the node's synchronizer state.
- `public void SetMultiplayerAuthority(int id, bool recursive = true)` - Gives the node (and, by default, every node below it) to a peer.
- `public bool IsMultiplayerAuthority()` - True when this peer owns the node (always true offline).
- `public Error Rpc(StringName method, params Variant[] args)` - Calls an [Rpc] method on every other peer (and here too when it is call_local).
- `public Error RpcId(long peerId, StringName method, params Variant[] args)` - Calls an [Rpc] method on one peer (negative: on everyone but that peer).
- `public void RpcConfig(StringName method, Variant config)` - Sets (or, with nil, removes) one method's RPC settings: a dictionary with rpc_mode, transfer_mode, call_local and channel (Godot's rpc_config).
- `public Variant GetRpcConfig()` - Every RPC method of this node as a dictionary of settings, by name (Godot's get_rpc_config).
- `public virtual void _EnterTree()` - Called when the node enters the tree, parents before children.
- `public virtual void _ExitTree()` - Called when the node leaves the tree, children before parents.
- `public virtual void _Ready()` - Called once when the node and all its children have entered the tree: children first.
- `public virtual void _Process(double delta)` - Called every frame.
- `public virtual void _PhysicsProcess(double delta)` - Called on every fixed physics step.
- `public virtual void _Input(InputEvent @event)` - Called for each input event, before the UI and before _UnhandledInput.
- `public virtual void _UnhandledInput(InputEvent @event)` - Called for input events nothing before it handled (call GetViewport().SetInputAsHandled() to stop an event).
- `public virtual void _UnhandledKeyInput(InputEvent @event)`
- `public override void OnEnterTree()` - Inherited documentation.
- `public override void OnBeginPlay(BeginReason reason)` - Inherited documentation.
- `public override void OnExitTree()` - Inherited documentation.
- `public override void OnEndPlay(EndReason reason)` - Inherited documentation.
- `public override void OnParentChanged()` - Inherited documentation.
- `public override void OnTick(float dt)` - Inherited documentation.

### Tween

`public class Tween : RefCounted` - Animates properties, calls and intervals in sequence or in parallel (Godot's Tween).

- `public event Action Finished`
- `public event Action<long> StepFinished`
- `public event Action<long> LoopFinished`
- `public Tween()`
- `public PropertyTweener TweenProperty(GodotObject @object, NodePath property, Variant finalVal, double duration)` - Animates a property of an object from its value when the step starts to finalVal.
- `public IntervalTweener TweenInterval(double time)` - Waits time seconds.
- `public CallbackTweener TweenCallback(Callable callback)` - Calls a callable when its step is reached.
- `public MethodTweener TweenMethod(Callable method, Variant from, Variant to, double duration)` - Calls a method every frame with a value interpolated from from to to.
- `public SubtweenTweener TweenSubtween(Tween subtween)` - Runs another tween as one step of this one: it plays for its own length and this tween waits for it.
- `public Tween SetParallel(bool parallel = true)` - Makes every tweener from now on run alongside the previous one (or, with false, one after the other).
- `public Tween Parallel()` - Makes only the next tweener run alongside the previous one.
- `public Tween Chain()` - Makes the next tweener start after the previous step (undoes SetParallel for one tweener).
- `public Tween SetLoops(int loops = 0)` - How many times the tween plays; 0 is forever.
- `public int GetLoopsLeft()`
- `public Tween SetSpeedScale(float speed)`
- `public Tween SetTrans(TransitionType trans)` - The transition tweeners use unless they name their own (default Linear).
- `public Tween SetEase(EaseType ease)` - The ease tweeners use unless they name their own (default InOut).
- `public Tween SetProcessMode(TweenProcessMode mode)`
- `public Tween SetPauseMode(TweenPauseMode mode)`
- `public Tween SetIgnoreTimeScale(bool ignore = true)`
- `public Tween BindNode(Node node)` - Binds the tween to a node: it stops when the node is freed, waits while the node is out of the tree, and (by default) pauses when the node does.
- `public void Play()` - Starts or resumes the tween.
- `public void Pause()`
- `public void Stop()` - Stops the tween and rewinds it to its beginning; Play starts it again.
- `public void Kill()` - Ends the tween now; it cannot be used again.
- `public bool IsRunning()`
- `public bool IsValid()`
- `public double GetTotalElapsedTime()`
- `public bool CustomStep(double delta)` - Steps the tween by hand (for a tween that was stopped, or one driven from a script).
- `public static Variant InterpolateValue(Variant initial, Variant delta, double elapsed, double duration, TransitionType trans, EaseType ease)` - The value elapsed seconds into a duration-second move from initial by delta along the curve (Godot's Tween.interpolate_value).
